lines.text: Venus. Surface pressure is ninety-two times Earth, and the ground sits near 465 degrees - hotter than Mercury, even though it is farther from the sun.
It is raining acid. Do not touch the green pools. The saucers love this haze - keep your blaster warm.
Hull Plating recovered. Watch the acid - the walk back matters as much as the walk in.
Plating stowed. Ninety-two atmospheres out there, and we just walked it.
Acid pools glow green. Around, never through.
Saucers telegraph their shots with a glow. Jump sideways as they fire.
Stomp the crawlers from above - their shells laugh at everything else.
